_comment: Pre-existing violations found when check_ui_business_logic.js was widened
from three directories (js/ui, js/pages, components) to all of js/ with the
engine tree allowlisted. New violations fail the build; these are grandfathered.
This list is a ratchet, not an exemption: removing an entry is the last step
of fixing it, and the check fails on an entry that no longer reproduces, so
the file can only shrink. Run with UI_LOGIC_NO_BASELINE=1 to see the raw list.

knownViolations.note: Private XP accumulator defined at :136 and called 14x. A second XP economy parallel to SparkProgress.awardXp; should route through ProgressEngine.
Defines the 0.7/0.3 mastery smoothing rule at :3. Delegates to SparkMastery when present but keeps a divergent inline copy; the rule belongs in ProgressEngine.
Owns the unlock decision at :17 (skill-point cost check and spend). Unlock policy belongs in ProgressEngine/CurriculumEngine.
